newsitem.title: UK: Mauritius Sept sugar output up slightly yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius Sept sugar output up slightly yr/yr.

text.p: Mauritius produced 134,758 tonnes of sugar in September 1996, up from 131,472 in the same 1995 period, the Mauritius Sugar Syndicate (MSS) said in a statement on Tuesday.
Sugar exports totalled 82,976 tonnes for the month, after 69,076 in September 1995, the statement said.
The bulk were destined for the UK, with token amounts going to Spain, Germany and Belgium.
Portugal received 15,000 tonnes under the European Union's agreement on Special Preferential Sugar.
Closing September stocks reached 139,780 tonnes against 114,381 a year earlier, the MSS said.
Cumulative production amounted to 396,362 tonnes for the January-September 1996 period, compared with 331,453 in the same period last year.
The MSS said cumulative exports were 419,520 tonnes, against 367,097 previously.
